goal: Ensure address queries and P2P responses return the full requested quota even when many peers are banned
Avoid underfilling address responses when valid alternative addresses are available
reviewability: Waiting on author response to design and test coverage feedback
Review would repeat open questions (ajtowns, frankomosh, sipa)
agreement: Concept approval for filtering during selection to avoid leaking banlist size (mzumsande, frankomosh, sipa)
Objection: predicate design adds unnecessary complexity over simpler oversampling (fjahr, Bicaru20)
Unaddressed suggestion: evict banned addresses directly rather than filtering on query (ajtowns)
Unaddressed suggestion: unify all selection parameters into the callback interface (sipa)
Unaddressed concern: tests do not verify that a filtered request still meets the target count (frankomosh)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because underfilled address responses only manifest under heavy ban or discouragement states
Minor privacy benefit by preventing peers from inferring banlist size, but change is deferrable
